description: This file contains error handling utilities for a software project, including functions for parsing, classifying, and formatting error messages related to API errors, timeouts, rate limits, and specific provider errors. It also exports functions for error detection and user-facing message generation.

methods.description: Generates a billing error message string based on provider and model info.

methods.name: formatRateLimitOrOverloadedErrorCopy
methods.description: Returns user-facing message for rate limit or overloaded errors.

methods.name: formatTransportErrorCopy
methods.description: Provides user-friendly messages for network-related errors.
